title: AI Benefits Database
description: Search seven sourced records of AI benefits, with evidence, beneficiaries, and conditions for reproduction.

title: Compare AI benefits
description: Compare reported gains, evidence, beneficiaries, and conditions in their own terms.

title: AI Benefits Database method
description: How gains, beneficiaries, evidence, persistence, and reproduction are documented.

title: Two hikers found and guided to safety
description: An AI-assisted drone search helped locate two overdue hikers. Ground teams guided both to safety.

title: Firefighters alerted before the first 911 call
description: The AI alert arrived at 05:19. Firefighters were on scene before the first 911 call at 06:01.

title: Incidental lung cancer diagnosed and treated
description: A flagged lung nodule was investigated. One patient received a stage IB lung cancer diagnosis and surgery.

title: Same-day contact after an X-ray
description: Dianne Covey was contacted the afternoon of her X-ray. Further investigation identified stage I lung cancer.

title: Back to work, exercise, and family life
description: After clot-removal surgery, Carol Wilson returned home within two days and later reported resuming work, exercise, and childcare.

title: Higher physics test scores with an AI tutor
description: Immediate physics test performance improved with the designed AI tutor: an adjusted effect of 0.63 standard deviations versus classroom active learning.

title: Historians reconstructed text more accurately
description: On masked known text, historians’ top-choice reconstruction accuracy was 71.7% with Ithaca, compared with 25.3% unaided.

title: Support agents resolved more issues per hour
description: Access to an AI assistant increased resolved customer issues per hour by about 15% on average in one software company.

title: Professional writing tasks took less time
description: In a randomized writing experiment, ChatGPT access reduced average task time by 40% and increased assessed output quality by 18%.

title: Developers completed a coding task sooner
description: Among developers who finished the task, those assigned GitHub Copilot completed a JavaScript HTTP server in 55.8% less time, averaging 71.17 versus 160.89 minutes.
